scope: Representation matching only. The chosen mediator mass uses unweighted opposite-character pairing, not SU3 trace pairing. Restoring SU3 in this singlet model yields only a function of the invariant bilinear and reinstates family flat directions (for nonzero B, modulo E6 U1). A single E8 adjoint commuting chiral superfield has no cubic invariant; E8 gauge dynamics or multiple fields are not excluded.
